links.outcome: Discrimination of ACCEPT versus exacerbation history (standard of care) for predicting moderate/severe exacerbations
links.effect: ACCEPT 2.0 AUC 0.77 outperformed any and frequent exacerbator categories (AUC 0.69 and 0.67); ACCEPT 3.0-UK net beneficial and superior to exacerbation history across wide range of thresholds.
links.quote: ACCEPT 2.0 achieved an AUC of 0.77 for predicting moderate/severe exacerbations, outperforming both any and frequent exacerbator categories (AUC: 0.69 and 0.67, respectively).

links.outcome: Calibration (O/E ratio) before and after local recalibration of ACCEPT
links.effect: ACCEPT 2.0 overpredicted (O/E 0.81, 95% CI 0.80 to 0.81); recalibration gave O/E 1.00 (0.99 to 1.00) while maintaining AUC 0.77.
links.quote: Recalibration resolved this overprediction, yielding O/E ratio of 1.00 (95% CI 0.99 to 1.00), while maintaining discrimination (AUC: 0.77).

links.effect: ACCEPT 2.0 overpredicted: O/E ratio 0.81 (95% CI 0.80 to 0.81).
links.quote: However, it overpredicted exacerbation events (observed-to-expected (O/E) ratio: 0.81 (95% CI 0.80 to 0.81)).
